title: model-directory: add compatibility scopes, streaming-ready hints, and tiered billing fields to listing API
author: Priya Singh
description: Motivation: clients need richer filtering and billing metadata from the model listing endpoint to make routing and cost-aware decisions without extra calls. This PR introduces three orthogonal additions to the model directory API: 1) compatibility_scopes: coarse-grained flags that indicate if a model is compatible with OpenAI tools/fn-calling, streaming-first delivery, or embedding-only workloads. 2) streaming_ready_hints: lightweight per-model suggestions for preferred chunk sizes, max_chunk_latency_ms and recommended stream backpressure behavior to improve stability for clients using streaming. 3) billing_tiers: explicit fields describing unit pricing buckets and soft limits so SDKs and edge routers can surface cost estimates. Design summary: we extended the v1 models listing response to include arrays of compatibility_scopes (enum strings), an optional streaming_hints object flattened into fields (stream_chunk_hint, max_chunk_latency_ms, prefers_chunked_responses), and a billing_tiers array of compact records (tier_name, token_price_usd, max_tokens_soft_limit). To preserve backward compatibility we keep all new fields optional and documented in the OpenAPI spec. We also added a new query param scope_filter to allow server-side filtering by one or more compatibility scopes (e.g., ?scope_filter=streaming,openai_compat). Rollout: feature gated behind toggles; default off for older clients. Migration notes: SDKs will map billing_tiers to their local cost-estimate helpers; servers will continue to return legacy price_hint if billing_tiers absent. Tests and validation: unit tests for JSON schema validation, integration test exercising streaming_hint usage in the streaming canary harness, and manual spot checks against the openai-compat shim. Non-goals: this PR does not modify runtime routing or billing engine calculations, only the API metadata surface. Related: addresses ENG-7421 and adds observability hooks requested in PM-1980. Checklist: [x] API changes implemented and documented in swagger [x] SDK stubs updated for TS/Python [x] unit/integration tests added [x] docs draft for Console listing UI [x] feature flag controlled and can be backfilled server-side

review_comments: Evan Chen: Can we keep the streaming_hint fields as nullable ints instead of strings to avoid client parsing? Also request explicit max_streaming_chunk_tokens in addition to latency.

Marisol Vega: Please ensure billing_tiers is compact; large arrays might blow up listing responses for thousands of models. Suggest adding a tier_sample_limit response flag.
Priya Singh: Added tier_sample_limit and server will only return full billing_tiers when expanded via ?expand=billing_tiers. Default is tier_summary.

release_notes: Added compatibility_scopes and scope_filter to the models listing API to allow filtering by OpenAI compatibility and streaming-readiness.
Added streaming_ready_hints to provide clients with chunk and latency recommendations for more stable streaming sessions.
Added billing_tiers and tier_summary/tier_sample_limit behavior to surface unit pricing metadata for cost estimation.
notes_for_eng: Server-side flag redwood.features.model_directory_enhanced_metadata controls behavior. Ops: when enabling, monitor model-directory-mismatch.alert and increased payload sizes. SDKs have default fallbacks if new fields absent.
qa_steps: 1) Enable feature flag in staging. 2) Call GET /v1/models?scope_filter=streaming and confirm only streaming-ready models returned. 3) Open streaming connection to a model with streaming_ready_hints and measure chunk latencies against the hint. 4) Verify SDK cost estimate uses billing_tiers when present and falls back to legacy price_hint when absent.
